commands.chord_paper_sim: cargo bench -p rings-core --bench chord_paper_sim --no-default-features --features dummy -- --include all > benchmark-results/dht/chord-paper-sim-2026-07-08.jsonl
commands.chord_paper_fig_9_smoke: cargo bench -p rings-core --bench chord_paper_sim --no-default-features --features dummy -- --include fig_9 > /tmp/chord-paper-fig9-2026-07-08.jsonl

paper_sim_source: crates/core/benches/chord_paper_sim.rs in current PR branch after rebasing on PR #660; Fig. 9 uses rings_core::dht::StorageVirtualNodes runtime storage-vnode derivation
notes: PR #660 implements storage-only virtual positions derived from physical owner DIDs; they are not independent signing identities and do not create routing/finger-table virtual peers.
chord-paper-sim-2026-07-08.jsonl maps the original Chord paper's numbered tables and data figures to local Rust rows.
Fig. 9 rows use runtime storage virtual-node derivation from rings_core::dht::StorageVirtualNodes over deterministic 160-bit Rings DIDs and placement keys.
Docker convergence and transport artifacts still use the 2026-07-05 rings-node-cluster image and were not recollected in this supplement.
